Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
200 AM EDT Sat Sep 19 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Eastern Subtropical Atlantic (AL99):
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the low pressure system 
located several hundred miles southwest of the Azores have changed 
little in organization during the past several hours. A tropical 
depression could still form later today. The system is expected to 
move slowly over the next couple of days, remaining southwest of the 
Azores, followed by a turn to the southwest by early next week. 
Environmental conditions are forecast to become less favorable for 
development beginning Sunday night or on Monday. 
* Formation chance through 48 hours...high...80 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.
